sections.content: Food and drink often come in containers. Hungarian uses words like 'pohár' (glass), 'üveg' (bottle) with specific serving words.

items.english: I request one bottle of water.
I request one glass of tea.
I request one piece of apple.

sections.content: When giving a measure word, use 'egy' (one) and the number takes the accusative -t: 'egy üveg vizet', not 'egy üveg víz'.
